author: ekomzo
body_preview: ### Reproduction  `renderToStream` creates a new style cache for every render (`styleCache: new Map()`), and `processStyleClass` stores generated `css()` rules only in that cache. title: css(): @property, @font-face and other descriptor at-rules are nested inside the class rule
author: brookslybrand
body_preview: ### Reproduction  `css()` hoists `@keyframes` and `@function` out of the class rule, but every other at-rule is nested with the element selector. For at-rules whose body is descriptors rather than rules (`@property`, `@font-face`, `@counter-style`, `@font-palette-values`, `@page`), that output is invalid, so the browser drops it. title: component: an undefined or null host prop removes its attribute on every render
author: brookslybrand
body_preview: ### Reproduction  A host prop passed as `undefined` (or `null`) removes its attribute on **every** render, even when the previous value was also `undefined`. Any attribute browser code sets on that element (a third-party script, `toggleAttribute()`, an animation helper) is wiped by the next unrelated `handle.update()`.
